reviews.author: Tracey Smith
reviews.text: Came here with my son. Ordered goyoza, ramen chicken/noodle dish and green dragon roll. I asked for a coconut mango matcha latte but was told they didnt have any, dispite flyers on every table advertising it. I then asked for a lychee juice (something I have everytime I visit your aberdeen store), server didn't know and would have to check. My sons ramen came and it was missing the pork and I never got a drink to have with my food, not by choice. When we asked for containers to take the food home they didn't bring enough and we had to ask for one more for my sons ramen. We didnt get a bag, we were not offered so as we were carrying out 4 containers of food someone not in uniform asked us if we would like a bag. If this had been my first experience in a maki and ramen I would not hurry back. But within the last 7 days I have been to your aberdeen store, here everything is exceptional especially the staff and service. I have also visited your Leith store, which was good. We were told the visit today was below par because the staff were new!

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text: Really tasty, I got the vegan black garlic oil tonkotsu ramen which was delicious, I haven’t had such a rich and flavourful ramen broth in a long time and the garlic oil was the perfect addition. I was initially cautious of the vegan bacon but it was a pleasant addition to the meal. My partner got the vegan chicken katsu and also enjoyed it. The interior decor is nice with the cherry blossoms. The service was positive and kind, though we did find the entrance to the restaurant to be slightly unclear with where to wait and it took a while before a waiter came to sit us down. I did enjoy the little bong on the gong for each customer, that was a cute touch!

reviews.text: I visited today with my giant breed assistance dog which often makes me nervous for access challenges, nothing was too much trouble and the dog was completely ignored. We were shown to a table with ample space for the dog to work and lay beside us. I had to make changes to the dishes for dietary reasons again this was no issue. The staff worked seamlessly around the dog like she wasn’t there (it’s rare). The food was lovely. The atmosphere, service and accessibility was fantastic. Thank you maki and ramen staff for enabling myself and my partner to have a very enjoyable dinner date while working an assistance dog it’s rare and we will be back

reviews.text: We had lunch today, booked in advance but we had to queue outside. We were in 2 but were served 10/15mins apart, no drinks were served until we reminded about them. At some point after lunch we were asked to leave as the table was booked, which is fine but why not offering us to move to a non-booked table given that the majority were empty?! Maybe short of staff but no apologies offered. Will not book again.

reviews.author: Ann Roberts
reviews.text: First visit. I ordered steak ramen the menu stated medium rare. It came very well done and broth was lukewarm. I sent it back. The waitress said the chef is preparing you a fresh one. It came back 2 minutes later steak was overdone and tough. It had obviously been nooked and reheated in a microwave. My daughter ordered the chicken Laksa and complained that the chicken was compressed sliced chicken not good for value for £18.50. We complained to the manager. She said she had no idea whether the chicken came in prepacked or ready cooked. She said we would not have to pay. We would have refused anyway as we had one mouthful each. The Manager offered us complimentary cocktails or desserts we refused and she gave us £40 vouchers which we still haven't used. Considering they are just up from Waggamommas they have strong competition and honestly not a patch on Waggas they really need to to their game.

reviews.text: our first server didn’t set table for us and then once we sat down didn’t attend to us until flagged down 20 minutes later Thankfully, Amidu, saved the day by being very attentive, apologised and help fix the orders that had been written down wrong (chicken given to veggies etc) also on a more positive note, GREAT vegan black garlic tonkotsu ramen. best i’ve had.

reviews.author: Mia
reviews.text: The first server seated us to our table and took ages to come back and serve us. We had to ask her to take our order because we were waiting for over 20 minutes. She got our order completely wrong and we had the wrong ramen delivered and she also ordered us chicken gyozas instead of veggie (we are vegetarians). She also hadn’t set the table so once the food did arrive, we had to try and find cutlery/napkins ourselves. Luckily and thankfully, Amidu took over and he helped to rectify things. He was really kind and helpful; great customer service from him! The food tasted nice but maybe not be the best place for vegans and vegetarians as you may accidentally be given meat.

reviews.author: Mari K
reviews.text: Had lunch here a while ago and was excited because of the raving reviews. Honestly not sure how they got these as the foods was extremely mediocre. Just another influencer spot that has the looks but not the goods. Staff was super lovely but clearly understaffed and a little unsure of how to handle busy periods. London has to stop with these inauthentic, mediocre, money grabbing places and needs to go back to prioritising businesses with unique, original and passion led cuisine.

reviews.author: manesh Patel
reviews.text: Went there nearly 2 weeks ago for a birthday. Used their 50% off food discount. Atmosphere was pretty good and so was the food. Service however was astonishingly poor on the day. Apparently some staff didn't turn up and even though the place wasn't busy, it was one staff member for the entire resturant. This meant food and service was significantly delayed and some luke warm food served. This isn't the fault of the staff memeber. However we also realised after paying and leaving the venue that the discount applied was incorrect and i have been over charged. Tried emailing and calling to get this resolved with proof of reciept. No answer. Please get in touch with me to resolve! Been nearly 2 weeks now and still unresolved.

reviews.author: Mariem
reviews.text: The food was honestly 100/10, everything was delicious, beautifully presented, and it was amazing to have such a great halal Japanese dining option locally. Even the kids loved it, which is always a huge bonus! But what really stood out was the outstanding service. From the moment we arrived, the staff were so welcoming, attentive and genuinely lovely. A special mention to Tinky and Diana, who went above and beyond to make our visit so enjoyable. Their warmth, professionalism and attention to detail really made a difference. It’s not often you get amazing food AND exceptional service together, but Maki & Ramen absolutely delivered. We’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fantastic halal Japanese dining experience in Southampton!

reviews.author: RACE MAK
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my meal at Maki Nori in Soho. The handrolls were freshly made and the A5 Wagyu and Duck Foie Gras ones were definitely my favourites. The sashimi was fresh too, and I really liked the presentation of the sushi boat with dry ice. We also had the Hokkaido Cheese Tart for dessert, which was a nice way to finish the meal. Overall, a lovely place for a date night or special occasion. Would definitely come back!
